cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：口香糖；牙龈
cards.example_en: The teacher asked us not to chew gum in class.
cards.example_zh: 老师叫我们上课时不要嚼口香糖。

cards.example_en: The rain started just as we reached home from practice.
cards.example_zh: 我们训练完刚到家，雨就下起来了。

cards.example_en: Smoke rose from the house at the end of our street.
cards.example_zh: 烟从我们这条街尽头的房子里冒了出来。

cards.example_en: Warm weather will increase the sales of cold drinks.
cards.example_zh: 天气变暖后，冷饮的销量会增加。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：独立的
cards.example_en: She became more independent at university.
cards.example_zh: 她在大学里变得更加独立。

cards.example_en: Bike insurance paid for a new wheel after the crash.
cards.example_zh: 自行车保险在事故后赔了一只新车轮。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：伊斯兰的
cards.example_en: The family prepares special food for Islamic festivals.
cards.example_zh: 这家人会为伊斯兰节日准备特别的食物。

cards.example_en: A painting of Jesus hangs above the church door.
cards.example_zh: 一幅耶稣的画像挂在教堂大门的上方。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：欢乐；喜悦
cards.example_en: Pure joy showed on his face when the puppy arrived.
cards.example_zh: 小狗到的时候，他脸上满是喜悦。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：关键的
cards.example_en: Timing is a key skill in the relay race.
cards.example_zh: 在接力赛里，把握时机是一项关键技能。

cards.example_en: The kid across the hall lent me a spare pencil.
cards.example_zh: 走廊对面的小孩借给我一支备用铅笔。

cards.example_en: Mum is washing vegetables in the kitchen before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭前，妈妈正在厨房里洗蔬菜。

cards.example_en: That lad from next door walks my dog after school.
cards.example_zh: 隔壁那个小伙子放学后会遛我的狗。

cards.example_en: Lock your bicycle before you enter the bookshop.
cards.example_zh: 进书店之前，先把自行车锁好。

cards.example_en: The loss of two players weakened our team before the final.
cards.example_zh: 两名队员的损失让我们队在决赛前变弱了。
